name: 江湖风云2
english_name: Rivers and Lakes in Turmoil II
english_description: In-game titled "Rivers and Lakes in Turmoil II: Liaoning Storm Rising," a Jin Yong-themed wuxia mudlib with a full sect/city map (Huashan, Wudang, Emei, Gaibang, Mingjiao, and dozens more) that deliberately mixes those sect scenes with real-world landmarks like Tiananmen. Character creation rolls six attributes rather than the usual four, including two hidden traits ("Fortune" and "Looks"). File comparison found its map directory structure nearly matches this project's "Tianya" (Ends of the Earth) family (tybxjh, xhcii, zxty, ffxymud), and its "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene matches tybxjh's word for word (confirmed by direct diff, formatting differences aside) — making this the sixth confirmed member of that family, a relationship no archive had previously recorded. Deep testing ran a full death/revival cycle cleanly and found/fixed a handful of this project's recurring bug classes (debug object references leaking into the registration prompt, a food/water gate reading the wrong object); see NOTES.md for a later-reverted §7.68 "fix" judged to be intentional ghost-wandering design rather than a bug.
